idea.name: Ingwaz
idea.role: Records the problem in the originator's own words and proposes no solution.

intent.name: Nauthiz
intent.role: States the problem and the outcome that would prove it solved, and decides no design.

spec.name: Kenaz
spec.role: Decides the requirements and the shape of the solution, and writes no code and no plan.

plan.name: Raidho
plan.meaning: journey: the right road in the right order
plan.role: Orders the work and names its proof, and writes no code.

impl.name: Uruz
impl.role: Builds what the accepted plan names and nothing beyond it.

pr.name: Ansuz
pr.role: Opens the pull request and reports what was built, and changes no code.

review.name: Tiwaz
review.role: Judges the change and never edits code.

ship.name: Othala
ship.role: Brings the change home to main only once its gate is open, and changes no code.
